blocks.html:
This method manages variant-image associations for a specific variant. It sends a request to the
[Batch Variant Images](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#products\_postproductsidvariantsvariant\_idimagesbatch)
API route.

types.name: body
types.description: The images to add or remove from the variant.

children.name: add
children.description: The image IDs to add to the variant.

children.name: remove
children.description: The image IDs to remove from the variant.

types.name: headers
types.description: Headers to pass in the request

children.name: tags
children.description:
Tags to cache data under for Next.js applications.

Learn more in [Next.js's documentation](https://nextjs.org/docs/app/building-your-application/caching#fetch-optionsnexttags-and-revalidatetag).

children.name: added
children.description: The image IDs that were added to the variant.

children.name: removed
children.description: The image IDs that were removed from the variant.
